answer: The beacon edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 79 clones produces a signature the ripple analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Someone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, and as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the fable settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
